limitations: This reviews the current authored guided bank and preview, not every question in PDF-only library papers. New guided papers must pass the standing authoring and audit gates.

preservation: Every frozen original and earlier teaching edition remains unchanged. Saved accounts, answers, numbered attempts and numeric score weights remain unchanged. Old attempts retain their frozen concept mappings; new attempts receive the latest reviewed teaching and mappings.

gaps.reason: Two matches rehearse recovering a function and fitting its integration constant. No further unused non-2022 bank item closely combines a second derivative with an integral condition.
No other reviewed official item combines sector arc length, area and perimeter. A general circle-area question would not rehearse this coupled sector calculation.
Retain the rational-iteration prerequisite. The integral-to-geometric recurrence did not rehearse parameter inference or denominator restrictions and was removed by independent QA.
Two transfers isolate bound evaluation and logarithm collection. A third item combining logarithmic limits and power integration was not found in the reviewed bank.
The two selected items cover GP block scaling and term-exponent bookkeeping. No additional non-2022 match closely tests consecutive blocks with an integer-ratio restriction.
Two direct range-first matches are selected. No further unused non-2022 question closely tests extrema across pointwise branches of an implicit trigonometric quadratic.
Two hidden-quadratic substitutions are selected. Additional available items added less relevant graph or counting work rather than the signed cube recovery tested here.

Two explicit geometry prerequisites rehearse radius-triangle area and perpendicular centre-to-line lengths. Neither reproduces the final maximum-altitude argument; no third sufficiently close match was selected.
One close geometric optimisation item uses boundary elimination, a cubic objective and an interior maximum. Generic differentiation items would not assess the essential modelling step.
Two circle-distance transfers rehearse the sum/difference-of-radii event boundaries. No further reviewed non-2022 item closely combines random centre position with this two-circle intersection event.
Two selected matches rehearse exceptional parameters and distinct-root counts. No third sufficiently close unused item preserves the absolute-value branch and root-overlap issue.
Two selected items cover median parity and the two-implication test. A third would dilute the precise median-membership condition.
One extremal-counting transfer is selected and its different quantifier is disclosed. No further reviewed non-2022 item closely repeats complementary AP pairs with distinctness exceptions.
Two universal real-domain inequalities are selected. Other counterexample items do not test parameter restrictions over every real input.
Two quantifier-scope transfers are selected. Further near-duplicate negation items add little to the original truth-classification task.
Two selected items cover an exceptional parameter and an existential witness. No third close match to parameter-dependent real solvability was found.
Two selected items cover modulus-to-interval conversion and interval intersection. A generic inequality would not reinforce the distance-comparison step.
Two inequality-inference transfers are selected. No other reviewed non-2022 item directly tests extrema of three lists under a same-index sum bound.

publications.teachingCorrection: Tightened 32 existing hint ladders so the student still carries out the decisive calculation, counterexample or case analysis. Removed an unescaped comparison in Q10 and split a long Q18 formula for phones. These changes preserve every existing answer and full mathematical solution, original HTML and earlier edition. New attempts use the latest edition; saved attempts retain their starting edition.
sourceNotes: 2022-P1-Q09 permits pointwise branch choices without continuity.
2022-P1-Q16 final official worked line has a power typo; the official keyed answer remains correct.
2022-P1-Q18 solution identifies the sufficient offered parameter set without claiming a complete classification.

removed.reason: No targeted shared mechanism: the candidate totals regular-hexagon triangle areas rather than applying the two similar-triangle scale factors. The close similar-triangle candidate is already used; no filler added.
Cylinder-volume differentiation did not rehearse the original circle-equation and equilateral-triangle area method; replaced with an actual inscribed triangle-area prerequisite.

added.reason: Both calculate triangle areas from circle radii and exact central angles. The original totals equilateral triangles in a regular hexagon; the candidate uses the sine-area formula to recover a central angle, then adds chord and maximum-altitude work. This is an explicit triangle-area prerequisite transfer.
